name: Business request intake to reviewed documentation (reference)

nodes.name: ITK 01 Receive request submission
nodes.notes: Slack interactivity endpoint. Receives the view_submission payload from the request modal. Field values are treated as untrusted input from here on.

nodes.name: ORC 09 Return validation failure to requester
REG 01 Create request record
nodes.notes: The registry is the state of record. Status lives here and nowhere else.

nodes.name: REG 02 Assign request identifier
nodes.notes: Known weakness: static data is not concurrency safe. See decision-log.md.

nodes.name: DFT 01 Load knowledge pack
nodes.notes: Knowledge pack and template for the resolved request type. If this fails, drafting must not proceed on a generic template.

nodes.name: DFT 02 Assemble agent instruction
nodes.notes: Delimiter collision is possible: a request body containing the closing delimiter would break the block. See agent-contract.md.

nodes.name: DFT 03 Generate draft
nodes.notes: The agent has no credentials of its own and no write access. It returns text to n8n, which performs every write under scoped permissions.

nodes.name: DFT 04 Parse draft and gap list
REV 01 Request reviewer approval
nodes.notes: Gap list is shown before the approve link, not after, and not collapsed. A reviewer who approves has been shown what is missing.

nodes.name: REV 02 Wait for reviewer decision
nodes.notes: Execution halts here indefinitely by design. There is no timeout that auto-approves. See decision-log.md PDR-004.

nodes.name: REV 03 Route reviewer decision
nodes.notes: No fallback output. An unrecognised decision value fails the execution rather than defaulting to any status.

nodes.name: PUB 01 Create documentation page
nodes.notes: RISK requests publish as draft regardless of approval. Approval authorises the record, not the activation of a fraud threshold.

nodes.name: REG 05 Set status Published and write back URL
nodes.notes: Reachable only downstream of REV 03. No other path writes Published.

parameters.text: ={{ $json.requestId }} was not approved. Reason: {{ $json.query.reason ?? 'not supplied' }}. Nothing was published.

nodes.name: REG 07 Set status Needs input after review

parameters.text: ={{ $json.requestId }} needs more from you before it can be published: {{ $json.query.reason ?? 'see reviewer comment' }}. The record stays open.

nodes.name: PUB 04 Request additional input from requester
